payload.text: ST0092, on vc's word of 2026-11-10: ic reads the dispatch-table rows ST0092's packages specify, as the table's owner. All six per-package reads (WP-03 to WP-07 and WP-09) went to vc and were RULED as ic recommended. vc writes them into the bodies in one chain. They add: INV-11 (one MCP tool per value of a valued slot, `value_facades` and `value_args`) riding cc's WP-02 bank, and INV-12 (only the mediator's session or a sessionless shell writes as the human seat, checked in the facade) riding cc's WP-05 bank. Further rulings: `wb retire` and `wb init` carry a recoverability_anomaly pointing at `wb register`'s; `--all` means 'include what the default hides'; `wb init` takes one positional `profile` 0..n; a dry run that meets a refusal exits 1; new doctor classes `roster-readme-edited` and `roster-readme-behind`, ids in FindingClass::as_str; and the three `wb brief` edges. NEXT: read each package's surface rows as cc or dc banks it, INV-11 and INV-12 among them, before vc judges, with findings one per message to the builder, copied to vc. Nothing is written to ST0092's canon. WP-10 is started and claimed only after cc's packages land, then AC-10.3's baseline is re-run (refs/bank/ic/st0092/wp10-ac-10.3-baseline.md, blob 32fee803e560).
